header.function_name: XD07 RPA Cross Dock Master to AP POLE

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: RPA on the AP POLE screens WLM9Q890 / WLM9Q860 instead of the SFTP interface file; source = XD01 Export Excel; part and destination scenarios; LAST_SYNC_DT (from Crossdock_ap_pole_guide.xlsx).

objective: To make the cross dock master of AP POLE equal to NSP by an RPA process on the AP POLE web screens (decided 17-Nov, replaces the SFTP interface file): part level on WLM9Q890 Cross Dock Kanban Part Master, destination level on WLM9Q860 Export Customer Cross Dock Master.

Source data: the Export Excel files of XD01 (Part List: Status, Part Name, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day; Mapping per Destination: Period, Destination Code, Dest Case/Day; sheet Active to Inactive), only the parts not synced yet (Sync Status No Sync / Waiting).

Part level: a part that became Active is added (or edited when AP POLE still has it), an Active part with a new Pcs/Case or Max Case/Day is edited, a part that went Active -> Inactive is deleted. Destination level: destinations are added, deleted or edited so that AP POLE has the same Buyer-PD and Max Shipping Box Qty as NSP.
Step by step guide with the AP POLE screens: deliverables/user_guide/Crossdock_User_Guide_AP_POLE.xlsx.

nodes.label: XD01 Export Excel (Part List, Mapping, Active to Inactive)
RPA: read the parts not synced yet
Part level: Add / Edit / Delete (4 scenarios)
WLM9Q860: destinations Add / Delete / Edit (4 scenarios)
Status per part, LAST_SYNC_DT, overall Sync Status, history

steps: [Sync] on XD01 sets the parts to Waiting (SYNC_STATUS = '3', IF_STATUS = '3' for 'GTOPAS' and 'APPOLE') and starts the RPA bot. Write LOG1. The whole run is inside one try-catch.

steps.text: The bot reads the source data: the XD01 Export Excel of Part List and of Mapping per Destination (ongoing period).
children: Parts to process = Sync Status No Sync / Waiting (not synced since the last change). Part level from Part List (Status, Part Name, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day); destination level from Mapping per Destination (Destination Code, Dest Case/Day); parts to delete from sheet Active to Inactive.

steps.text: AP POLE menu Master Maintenance > Cross Dock Kanban Part Master (WLM9Q890): Effective From = first day, To = last day of the month, Part No. = part of the source, [Search].
Part level (4.2): add, edit or delete the part on WLM9Q890.
children: Add / Edit: Shipping Box Qty = PCS_CASE, Max Shipping Box Qty = MAX_CASE_DAY, [Save]. Delete: tick the part, [Delete].

steps.text: Destination level (4.3): tick the part, [Maintain Cross Dock] (opens WLM9Q860), compare the Buyer-PD rows with the NSP destinations and add, delete or edit them; [Back].
children: Add: Buyer-PD = DEST_CODE (5-2 format), Order Type **, Transport Code 2, Max Shipping Box Qty = Dest Case/Day.
Total Shipping Allocated may not be more than Max Shipping Box Qty of the part: delete the destinations not in NSP before adding.

steps.text: Try-catch: any error (login, screen not available, timeout, AP POLE error message, source file not readable) stops the bot at once.
children: The whole run is Failed (one fails, all fail): LOG4 with the step, part and destination. Changes made before the error stay in AP POLE (no rollback on the screen); the next run compares again and completes the rest.

steps.text: Set the result of every Waiting part for 'APPOLE' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT and the overall Sync Status:
children: No error: IF_STATUS = '1', IF_DT and LAST_SYNC_DT = now, IF_MESSAGE = 'part <added / edited / deleted>, dest added <n>, deleted <n>, edited <n>'. Error: IF_STATUS = '2', IF_DT = now, LAST_SYNC_DT not changed.
TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: CHANGED_DT changed since step 2 -> '0' (No Sync); else 'GTOPAS' and 'APPOLE' both '1' -> '1' (Success), one '2' -> '2' (Failed), one still '3' -> stays '3'.
Insert TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE: event SYNC, source RPA, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, REMARK = 'APPOLE: ' + IF_MESSAGE.

steps: Write LOG2 with the counts (parts added / edited / deleted, destinations added / deleted / edited) and the status. Exit.

items: The Procurement team maintains the Part List and the D/S team the Mapping per Destination on XD01. Every change sets the part to No Sync.
The D/S team clicks [Sync] when the changes are complete; the RPA bot makes AP POLE equal to NSP (XD07) and GTOPAS (XD06).
RPA on the AP POLE web screens (decided 17-Nov): the SFTP interface file is no longer used. Part level on WLM9Q890, destination level on WLM9Q860 ([Maintain Cross Dock] of the ticked part).

Source data: the XD01 Export Excel files (Part List, Mapping per Destination, sheet Active to Inactive), parts not synced yet. Steps with the AP POLE screens: deliverables/user_guide/Crossdock_User_Guide_AP_POLE.xlsx.

items: The whole bot run is in one try-catch. Any error stops the run: login failed, screen not available, timeout, an AP POLE error message, source file not readable.
One fails, all fail: every Waiting part gets 'APPOLE' IF_STATUS = '2' (Failed) and the overall Sync Status Failed; LAST_SYNC_DT is not changed. The D/S team clicks [Sync] again.
Changes made before the error stay in AP POLE (no rollback on the screen). The next run compares again and completes the rest.
On Success: IF_STATUS = '1', IF_DT and LAST_SYNC_DT = date-time of the result (used by the sheet Active to Inactive of XD01, 4.3a).

AP POLE also accepts an upload: Report Type LM9Q900 - Upload Kanban Part Master (columns Effective Month, Effective Year, Operator ID, Part No., Part Name, Shipping Box Qty, Max Shipping Box Qty, Max Allowance Qty, ...) and LM9Q870 - Upload Export Customer Cross Dock Master (columns Effective Month, Effective Year, Part No., Buyer-PD, Order Type, Transport Code, Max Shipping Box (RCS), ...).
Whether the bot uses the screens (4.2 / 4.3) or the upload is to be confirmed (refer 4.6).

tables.name: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT
tables.description: Dummy table (proposed): send status of the cross dock master per part and target system (XD06 GTOPAS, XD07 AP POLE). The real output is the change made by the RPA on the target screens (GTOPAS WVJA5204, AP POLE WLM9Q890 / WLM9Q860). The overall Sync Status of the part stays in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
columns: Calculation period of the mapping sent (YYYYMM)
Date-time of the result of the target system

Date-time of the last Success of the part for this target (kept when a later run is Failed); NULL when never synced. A part is listed in "Active to Inactive" when it went Inactive after this date (17-Nov).
RPA run ID (GTOPAS and AP POLE)
Reason when Failed; blank when Success
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: Candidate part setting, one record per part (Part List data, no calculation period). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Minimum MAD (mandatory); reference compared with the MAD result of the calculation
Effective start date; required while the part is Candidate
Date-time of the last IF function result
Reason of the last Failed sync
Upload that last changed the record
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST
tables.description: Destination mapping, one record per part, calculation period and destination (Mapping per Destination data). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Calculation period, YYYYMM e.g. 202609; displayed as Sep 2026
Destination code (buyer code + PD code, 7 digits); exists in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION (Destination Master)
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). Read by the History setting modal of Part List (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). No retention limit: the history is kept (no housekeeping job, decided 30-Oct).
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC / CALC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (IF batch user ID for SYNC, batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change
